name: Terminal
description: The Terminal launcher in the workspace nav: open a new shell, see which terminals are running, jump into one or close it. UI only — the PTY shell itself (the terminal window chrome, /api/terminals, /ws/terminal/*) stays core-owned per the 2026-08-03 decoupling decision; this app owns the menu that drives it. Extracted out of aw-app-code-agent-clis so a plain terminal no longer lives under "Agents".
